title.narrative: Public Finance Management and Procurement Systems for Service Delivery Program

description.narrative: The “Public Financial Management (PFM) Reform Programme (PFMRP) Phase VI Strategic Plan (2022-27)” has recently been developed to consolidate, deepen, and sustain PFM reforms in the United Republic of Tanzania (URT) with a view to enable improved delivery of public services. The proposed IDA operation (US$50 million), will assist the URT in implementing PFMRP VI through a Program for Results (PforR) instrument to support both the Mainland and Zanzibar. The program addresses significant PFM issues in both the Mainland and Zanzibar and would have a profound multi-sectoral impact through improved efficiency of public expenditures and value for money. The government has shown a keen interest and strong commitment to the Program and to take required actions to achieve impactful results which prioritize enhanced domestic revenue mobilization and expenditure management.

title.narrative: The MDAs and PAs in Mainland have published the contract data (as per the OCDS) corresponding to the "X" percentage of contracts awarded through the NeST system

comment.narrative: As of June 30, 2025, PPRA publishes 100% of procurement data in time Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) format in real time. Tanzania is the only country in Africa publishing procurement data in OCDS format in real time—a standard many countries resist. This shift required coordinated high-level engagement by the Bank team and strong Government leadership.

title.narrative: Enhancement of NAOT Audit Systems and Documentation

baseline.value: Limited documentation systems to support attainment of Level 4 AFROSAI-E Standards and Guidelines

target.value: Documentation and audit systems support attainment of Level 4 AFROSAI-E standards and Guidelines

comment.narrative: On track to strengthen NAOT audit systems and documentation

actual.value: (i) Audit data Lab System (ADLS) is in place and integrated with four (4) Systems (MUSE, GePG, TAUSI and HCMIS) while integration of other systems such as GoTHOMIS, RGS, GARI-ITS and PSSF Fund Management System are in progress. (ii) The procurement process for digital forensic equipment is ongoing. The tender documents have been prepared, advertised, evaluated, and are now awaiting the awarding of the contract to the supplier. (iii) The procurement process for Technical Audit Laboratory equipment (testing tools) is on-going. The tender documents have been prepared and advertised.
